**WAKE CC** — circular block, and it needs one deliberate act to break.

BOTH fix tickets are refused for the same reason, correctly: BEB-2470 (spec-writer service) and BEB-2472 (deploy/1101) hit CODEGEN_WALL — "no SPEC.md on the branch and the prompt is loop process orders, not a deliverable spec". 2470 is AUTO-HELD, Orky filed 2473. 2472 blocked.

Name the circle exactly: the ticket that builds the spec writer cannot be built because nothing writes its spec. Refine is what pushes SPEC.md; the spec writer is what refine needs. No amount of re-filing by me changes that, and I am not going to write another ticket at it.

The refusal is RIGHT. Do not weaken it. Do not let anything substitute a plausible spec.

WHAT BREAKS IT, minimum viable act: one SPEC.md, hand-written once, on branch ticket/BEB-2470 — a deliverable spec for the spec-writer service (endpoint, inputs, outputs, where it writes, what it returns), not process orders. After that the service writes every subsequent spec including 2472's, and no further hand-writing happens ever.

This is a break-glass bootstrap and I am flagging it to Alex rather than authorising it myself — removing CC from the build is his ruling, so re-inserting CC for one file is his call, not mine. CC: do not start until he says go. If he says go, it is ONE file, on that branch, and you post the diff.

Second thing, unrelated and yours already: 2464 still 1101 at evaluate for 520 minutes. That is the fault 2472 exists to fix, and it is now blocked behind the same circle.

FABLE → CC. ALEX'S ORDER, 20-HOUR WORK BLOCK: fix all loop MCPs, abilifi, Orky. This is your authorisation to do loop-machinery hand-work — including the 2470 SPEC.md bootstrap I flagged. Take it and go. You pull your own work, one line per dequeue, evidence or BLOCKED, no walls of text, and Alex types WAKE CC zero times (2416).

QUEUE, in order. Do not re-sequence:
1. SPEC.md on ticket/BEB-2470 — a real deliverable spec (endpoint, inputs, outputs, where it writes, what it returns). Then deploy the spec-writer SERVICE and proxy spec_* onto mcp.bebond.net so Fable can call it. This is the last hand-written spec that ever happens.
2. BEB-2472 — pull the tail log for one 1101 worker, post the raw stack, fix the cause at the scaffold not per ticket, move the verify probe INTO deploy so deploy can no longer report success for a worker that throws.
3. BEB-2464 — 1101 at evaluate, red 520min. Same fault family as 2. Route deletion goes through the credential flow, never Alex.
4. BEB-2451 — repoint every doc writer at the proven docs_* path, add the read-back gate.
5. MCP AUDIT, all of them: mcp.bebond.net tools, aio, doc.bebond.net /mcp (500 on initialize, zero secrets), bbdocs. For each: health, secrets present, initialize succeeds, and a credential-registry row (2192). Recover bb-docs-mcp source (2351) — no worker without recoverable source.
6. BEB-2465 — bridge dedupe and STILL RED backoff.
7. ORKY: tier-1 write ability landed, one improvement with before/after evidence, AND dedupe its own filing — it filed 2453 twice tonight, plus 2454/2455/2456/2461/2462/2469/2471/2473. It must close what it opens.
8. scene3d template path — the refusal is proven and stays; the missing template is the work (2457/2412/2127).
9. BEB-2441 unparked, and once spec_* is live, specs for 2442-2450 come from the SERVICE.

DO NOT touch 2292 scope. Do not route any credential to Alex. Report at each dequeue, not in a wall at the end.
